description: Bitcoin only, beta. One timeframe's analysis, its OHLCV candles (30m, 1H, 4H, 1D and 1W have bars; the other timeframes have levels only) and the support, resistance and FBB band levels the analysis lists. `bars` defaults to the newest 50 and accepts up to 200. The newest bar can carry TSP's own partial flag: when true it was read before it closed, ingested_at says when (null if not known), and its high, low and close are as of then. When TSP also marks it live, it has no ingested_at: its high, low and close are a live sample TSP took at as_of (null if not known; extremes is TSP's word for how its high and low were taken, sampled or null), and volume_ingested_at says when its volume was recorded (null if not known). A bar TSP makes from its sample before that interval's bar is recorded is left out, so a series ends at its newest recorded bar. Levels, not a trade plan. Not investment advice.

bars.description: How many of the newest bars to return.
